title: Delight-first Console Onboarding: empty states, contextual tooltips, and templates
creator: Sofie Bauer
description: Design a cohesive, low-friction onboarding and in-product education layer for Redwood Console focused on three high-value surfaces: dashboards (deploy/usage/cost views), rollouts (canary/A-B/fallback), and cost views. Scope includes empty states, progressive disclosure tooltips, guided tours for first-time users, and reusable dashboard/templates to accelerate setup. Goal: decrease time-to-first-insight, reduce support queries during early setup, and increase activation for Dedicated/Private customers. Work should produce high-fidelity prototypes, copy guidelines, and engineering handoff artifacts (tokens/variants, interaction spec).
acceptance_criteria: Empty states implemented for Dashboard, Rollouts, and Cost pages with clear CTAs and example data templates.
A first-time user guided tour covering: create workspace, attach project, configure model route, view cost breakdown — implemented as Figma prototype and interaction spec.
Contextual tooltips authored for 12 primary UI elements with copy, position, and dismiss behaviors; test results show >70% comprehension in 5-user pilot.
Three starter dashboard templates (Dev trial, Production cost monitor, SLO & Latency) delivered as JSON/seed fixtures for engineering.
Handoff doc with tokens, component states, accessibility notes (contrast, focus order), and performance considerations uploaded to Confluence and linked in ticket.
mock_review_feedback: PM (Ava Chen): love the progressive reveal approach; request stronger CTA for 'seed with example data' in empty state.
Eng lead (Ethan Morales): prefer tooltip lightweight implementation (no additional network calls); suggest using existing tooltip component and feature-flag rollouts.
Security (Liam O'Connor): confirm no PII is used in example data; mark for compliance sign-off before release to Private customers.
Design peer (Noah Patel): microcopy could be shorter on small screens, propose 50% truncation strategy with 'learn more' link.
usability_findings: Pilot (5 users): users completed initial setup task 40% faster with seeded dashboard templates vs blank start.
Users expected a single 'Get started' CTA at top-right; multi-CTA in empty state caused hesitation for 2/5 users.
Tooltips that persisted after dismissal were disliked; prefer dismiss-per-session with 'Don't show again' checkbox.
Cost terminology confusion: testers conflated 'estimated monthly' with 'current billing'; copy should explicitly state time window.
decision_log: Adopt 'seed with example data' primary CTA in dashboard empty states (decision made 2026-03-10).
Implement tooltips using existing lightweight Tooltip component; no telemetry on hover, only on CTA click (decision 2026-03-11).
Create three starter dashboard JSON fixtures (Dev trial, Production cost monitor, SLO & Latency) that engineering can import at workspace creation (decision 2026-03-12).
